decks.notes: This UR Aggro deck focuses on playing low-cost creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent with damage. The key strategy is to play aggressively and efficiently, utilizing evasive creatures like Drake Hatcher and Monastery Swiftspear along with instant spells like Monstrous Rage and Torch the Tower to clear the way for attacks. By utilizing card draw with spells like Opt and Sleight of Hand, maintaining a consistent flow of threats is essential to apply constant pressure on the opponent. With a balanced mix of creatures and spells, this deck aims to win the game quickly through fast and relentless aggression.

This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of control cards and powerful creatures to dominate the battlefield. The key strategy involves disrupting the opponent's plans with cards like Get Lost and Temporary Lockdown, while also locking down their resources with Leyline Binding and Ride's End. The deck also aims to ramp up its mana quickly with cards like Up the Beanstalk and Floodfarm Verge to bring out formidable creatures like Overlord of the Hauntwoods and Zur, Eternal Schemer. By controlling the board and overwhelming the opponent with powerful cards, this deck aims to secure victory through strategic play.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and utilizing disruptive spells to control the board. It emphasizes a mix of evasive threats and removal spells to keep the pressure on the opponent while maintaining card advantage with cards like Enduring Curiosity. Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares are powerful finishers that can quickly end the game if left unchecked. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats that are difficult to deal with efficiently.

The deck focuses on aggressive strategies with a mix of low-cost creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing a combination of efficient creatures like Nurturing Pixie and Sunpearl Kirin, alongside disruptive spells like Temporary Lockdown and Get Lost, the deck aims to control the board and push for damage. Additionally, the inclusion of powerful cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Serra Paragon provides late-game potential to finish off the opponent. The mana base is built to support a consistent curve and ensure access to both white and black mana sources.

This control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through a combination of removal spells, hand disruption, and powerful creatures. The key concept revolves around generating card advantage while managing the board with removal and protection spells, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with strong creatures like Sheoldred and Archfiend of the Dross. The deck aims to control the game, disrupt the opponent's plans, and establish a dominant board presence to secure victory.

The deck is focused on quickly putting pressure on the opponent with low-cost aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Cori-Steel Cutter. Spells like Monstrous Rage and Burst Lightning provide additional reach and removal, while card draw and selection options like Opt and Sleight of Hand help maintain momentum. The mana base is optimized to ensure consistent access to both blue and red mana sources. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and powerful combination of creatures and spells to secure a victory.

The main concept of this UW Control deck is to use a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and card draw to control the game and outvalue the opponent. Cards like Soul Partition and No More Lies help with card advantage, while Day of Judgment and Ride's End help to clear the board. Elspeth, Storm Slayer and Marang River Regent provide win conditions and pressure on the opponent. Temporary Lockdown and Stock Up help to slow down the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to stay ahead on resources and eventually overwhelm the opponent with its powerful threats.

The key strategy of this deck revolves around aggressive gameplay using a combination of creatures with evasion, removal spells, and disruption to control the board and pressure the opponent. By utilizing low-cost creatures like Floodpits Drowner and Spyglass Siren, along with powerful threats like Preacher of the Schism and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent while denying them resources with cards like Duress and Spell Pierce. The goal is to steadily chip away at the opponent's life total and maintain board control to secure a victory.

This Jeskai Control deck focuses on delaying and disrupting opponent's plays while controlling the board with removal spells and counterspells. It also utilizes card draw and mana fixing to consistently stay ahead in resources. The win condition comes from efficiently managing threats and gradually taking over the game with powerful late-game cards. The deck aims to establish a strong board presence and outvalue the opponent in the long run, ensuring victory through careful planning and superior resource management.

The main concept of this deck is to use Omniscience to cast powerful spells for free, enabling a game-winning combo. Marang River Regent, Roiling Dragonstorm, and Moment of Truth are key components of the combo, while cards like Ephara's Dispersal and Temporary Lockdown provide control and protection. The deck also includes card draw and mana ramp to help set up the combo quickly. With the right combination of cards and timing, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a burst of powerful spells and take control of the game.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up to cast Omniscience, allowing you to cast your spells for free. Marang River Regent and Moment of Truth help protect your combo pieces while Roiling Dragonstorm acts as a finisher. Temporary Lockdown buys you time to assemble your combo. Adarkar Wastes and Seachrome Coast provide the necessary mana fixing for the deck. The goal is to control the board and overwhelm your opponent with powerful spells once Omniscience is in play, leading to a swift victory.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana to play Omniscience, allowing you to cast multiple spells for free. Marang River Regent and Roiling Dragonstorm are used as win conditions to deal massive damage to your opponent. Temporary Lockdown helps control the board until you can set up your combo. The deck also includes card draw and counter spells to help you find your combo pieces and protect them. Overall, the strategy revolves around efficiently getting Omniscience into play and overwhelming your opponent with powerful spells.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Cori-Steel Cutter, backed up by burn spells like Burst Lightning and Torch the Tower to deal direct damage to the opponent. The deck also includes card draw spells like Opt and Sleight of Hand to maintain card advantage and keep the pressure on the opponent. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced offense while controlling the board with counter spells like Spell Pierce and creature buffs like Monstrous Rage.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively attack the opponent using low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Slickshot Show-Off, supported by instant and sorcery spells to pump up their damage output. The inclusion of cards like Cori-Steel Cutter and Monstrous Rage further enhances the aggressiveness of the deck. The deck also includes cards for card draw and mana fixing to ensure a steady stream of threats. The mana base consists of a mix of Islands, Mountains, and dual lands to support the casting of both blue and red spells efficiently.

The deck focuses on fast and aggressive plays using low-cost creatures and spells to deal damage quickly. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of cheap creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Cori-Steel Cutter, supported by spells like Burst Lightning and Monstrous Rage. The deck also includes cards like Opt and Sleight of Hand to ensure consistency and draw power. Riverpyre Verge and other dual lands help fix mana and ensure the deck can cast its spells efficiently. Overall, the deck prioritizes speed and pressure to win the game quickly.
